title: record page read mode: inline edit exists only as an invisible "双击编辑" affordance, and each section's "显示 N 个空字段" toggle is separate and forgets its state on reload
body:
Filing gate **① a user-visible defect with a named landing site** (two read-mode affordances on the same page; split if triage prefers). Batch-of: 2026-10-25 browser pass on @objectstack/* 18.1.0 (second batch, 8 cards). Filed by the maintainer's account (`os-steve`) from the HotCRM pass driven in session `session_01AwpXhq2nFKU6J7GmbCEmZu`; ⛔ not a claim. Grade and routing are objectui triage's.

## What is seen (HotCRM on `@objectstack/console` 18.1.0)

1. **Inline edit is undiscoverable.** On an account record the DOM carries a `双击编辑` button per field (the pass counted 11 on Acme Corporation), but nothing on screen says so: no pencil on hover, no hint in the section header, no cursor change. A user who wants to change the phone number opens 编辑 and the whole five-tab form. The one visible pencil is on the Markdown description (the rich-text widget draws its own). [50-account-tall.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/50-account-tall.png).
2. **Empty-field toggles are per section and volatile.** An opportunity page shows 「显示 2 个空字段」, 「显示 9 个空字段」, 「显示 5 个空字段」 in three sections; a user who wants to see the whole record clicks three times, and after a reload (or opening the next opportunity) all three are folded again. [51-opportunity-tall.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/shots/51-opportunity-tall.png).

`reach:` the public UI, measured once as the dev admin; every record page shows both.

## Expected

- A visible inline-edit cue: a pencil on field hover (and focus), or a one-line hint under the tab bar the first time; the double-click stays.
- One page-level 「显示空字段」 control (or the section toggles) remembered per user and object in the `sys_user_preference` `ui.*` keys the list page already uses (#12418).

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` objectui "inline edit double click to edit has no visible affordance pencil hover on record details" → 24 hits, none about the affordance (#13292 save-bar label, objectstack-ai/objectui#12303 save feedback, objectstack-ai/objectui#12933, objectstack-ai/objectui#12642 …); "show N empty fields toggle per section resets on reload remember" → 4 hits (#12618, objectstack-ai/objectui#7064, objectstack-ai/objectui#8376, objectstack-ai/objectui#10291) about what counts as empty, not about remembering the toggle. Report: [REPORT.md](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/03c2ad1573fb93cf1318ab50ae22f9ba770c4166/qa/2026-10-25-browser-pass/REPORT.md).
